title: Bangladesh does not want Teesta dispute to hurt ties with India, says minister
description: The Teesta begins in the Himalayas and flows through Sikkim and West Bengal before entering Bangladesh. It eventually joins the Jamuna, which is the Bangladeshi name for the Brahmaputra. The river is particularly important to northern Bangladesh, where farmers depend on its water. It is also important to West Bengal for irrigation and power generation, with several districts in North Bengal relying on its waters.

The child was allegedly strangled after witnessing his father's death. Investigators suspect property was a motive for the alleged double murder. Harini confessed to the killings during police interrogation.

title: IAS officer who helped turn India's software industry into global powerhouse
description: N Vittal, the IAS officer and former Secretary of the Department of Electronics, played a key role in shaping India's software industry by removing regulatory barriers and promoting shared digital infrastructure. The article traces how a 1985 Texas Instruments satellite link, famously transported by bullock cart in Bengaluru, demonstrated India's potential for global software exports. Vittal later championed Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), helping companies access communication infrastructure, hardware and global markets while accelerating India's IT revolution.

title: Delhi researchers worry over mosquitoes that survived powerful insecticide
description: A recent study from the University of Delhi reveals that mosquitoes, particularly Aedes aegypti, may be becoming less susceptible to the widely-used insecticide alpha-cypermethrin. Laboratory results indicate a small reduction in the insecticide's effectiveness, and researchers discovered specific enzymes aiding in its breakdown. These findings underscore the necessity for diverse mosquito management techniques to ensure continued success in pest control efforts.

Meanwhile, the Arjuna Award will honor seventeen exceptional athletes for their achievements, while coaches are set to receive the Dronacharya Awards. Additionally, the Army Paralympic Node will be recognized with the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar for its significant contributions to sports.

The NSR stretches about 5,600 km across Russia’s Arctic waters. Much of the route remains covered by thick ice for most of the year.

The India wicketkeeper-batter became the first Indian cricketer to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket. Pant reached the milestone with a big six off Lahiru Kumara. The shot also brought up his 20th Test fifty.

Allegations of unreturned funds and management issues were also raised by supporters. The students seek fair treatment and better academic facilities from the institution. They warned of renewed protests if the chemistry teacher is not provided promptly.

title: ‘Enrol your kids in govt schools’: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke to ministers

Dipke's remarks followed his inspection of a government school in Santuk Pimpri. He found broken window panes and a lack of basic amenities there. The school principal was suspended after the activist's visit and complaints.

The court permitted the Centre to form an expert panel.  This panel will examine alternative execution methods for reduced pain.  Hanging remains the current method while reviews are pending.

Opposition leaders claim these men were actually employees from the health department rather than beneficiaries of social schemes. In contrast, the Aam Aadmi Party defends the dance as a positive expression.

Despite their fierce competition, neither wrestler emerged victorious, leading to an official draw. Their cash prize was equally split, marking a unique moment of camaraderie amid their political rivalry at the Bachau Veer Akhara on the Banaras Hindu University grounds.

The man retaliated by slapping the officer back during the heated exchange.  Police intervened and forcibly arrested the man after he refused to cooperate.  Authorities stated minimal force was used to contain the situation and prevent escalation.

Complaints poured in from students and parents regarding his lack of proper class management. His unsatisfactory answers to the show-cause notice led to this suspension order, sparked by a campaign initiated by Abhijeet Dipke in Hingoli. He is now subject to disciplinary actions governed by Maharashtra Zilla Parishad rules.

Failure to comply leads to a three-month license suspension and potential revocation.  Over one lakh certificates were prepared for drivers completing the basic Marathi course.  This initiative aims to improve communication between drivers and passengers across Maharashtra.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
description: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her approach allows acquiring and erasing patient debt at steep discounts. This model has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar initiatives. While philanthropic efforts provide immediate relief, policy reform remains stalled. Lasting change may require systemic reforms addressing the root causes of medical debt.
